response.rationale: All options map to the same top-ranked leaf 'Paraganglioma' with identical support and confidence scores. Therefore, the ranking is based on the specificity and comprehensiveness of the options. Option A is the most specific, detailing the SDH deficiency, location (prostate), and recurrence/multiplicity. Option C describes malignancy (metastatic or multifocal), which is supported by the vignette. Option D is less specific than A and C, only mentioning SDHB-related paraganglioma. Option B is the broadest, describing the syndrome rather than the specific tumor diagnosis.
